column3: Self deception sounds like a contradiction.
To lie, you have to know the truth. So how do you lie to the one person who already knows it?
But psychologists have caught people doing exactly that, again and again, in surprisingly simple experiments.
And it almost never looks like lying. It looks like not checking. Like arguing with bad news. Like quietly rigging the test.
Today: four tricks your brain uses to keep a secret from you. And why it bothers.
